research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Fivetran is researching centralized database management and synchronization. In Identifying Changes Between Source and Destination Databases using Snapshots of Databases and Centralized database management system for database synchronization using resizable invertible bloom filters with database snapshots, it uses snapshots and invertible bloom filters to reconcile distributed data efficiently. Source knowledge graph building in context of artificial intelligence based focuses on generating source knowledge from API documentation. These efforts center on data sync optimization and automated source understanding.

overview_description.description: Fivetran offers automated data integration and delivers ready-to-use connectors that automatically adapt as schemas and APIs change, ensuring consistent, reliable access to data. Fivetran improves the accuracy of data-driven decisions by continuously synchronizing data from source applications to any destination, allowing analysts to work with the freshest possible data. To accelerate analytics, Fivetran enables warehouse transformations and delivers source-specific analytics templates.

about_short_description.short_description: Fivetran is a technology company that automates replicating data into a cloud data platforms.

product.name: Fivetran Platform
product.description: A managed data movement platform for replicating, governing, transforming, and delivering data across applications, databases, warehouses, data lakes, and analytics environments.

product.name: Fivetran Connectors and Data Movement
product.description: Pre-built and customizable pipelines that replicate data from SaaS applications, databases, ERPs, files, and streaming sources into data warehouses, data lakes, and other destinations.

product.name: Fivetran Activations
product.description: Reverse ETL pipelines that sync modeled data from warehouses, lakes, and databases into CRMs, marketing platforms, support systems, and other business applications.

product.name: Fivetran Transformations
product.description: A managed service for running scheduled SQL transformations in data warehouses or other destinations to convert replicated data into analytics-ready datasets.

product.name: Fivetran Managed Data Lake Service
product.description: A managed service that delivers replicated data into open table formats such as Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake for standardized lakehouse storage and analytics.

product.name: Powered by Fivetran
product.description: An embedded data integration capability that lets software companies offer customer-facing data connections and synchronization within their own applications.
